why: Surface-only gold cannot qualify ANTECEDENT_RESOLVED / DOCUMENT_CONSTITUTED / EXTERNAL_UNRESOLVED, because those are DISCOURSE properties. Without these fixtures a context resolver could be built with no test for it (REVISION 3b).

schema.context: ordered sentences constituting the discourse up to and including the target
schema.resolves_to: for ANTECEDENT_RESOLVED only: the EXISTING admitted anchor whose identity must be REUSED. Must be a surface that actually occurs; never a canonical form invented for the fixture.
schema.graph_eligible: expected outcome of the single eligibility authority
schema.admitted_anchors: [(surface, core_type)] already admitted in this document; makes the fixture self-contained
